plan: Boost + rotation (surge exit, whipsaw switch (the whole account into TLT or GLD) with the rate/gold regime, TLT / GLD by 6-month gain, narrow-market cash week read from the equal-weight index’s full history, lower-high exit into gold or bonds on both its triggers, no T-bills: gold or bonds if up over 3 months, else DBMF managed futures (from its start in May 2019; cash before); price-break rule: the day SPY closes under its 100-day average for the first time with that average and its 7-day average both falling, the haven pick for 10 sessions; buy freeze: no new stocks for 10 sessions after a week ends with SPY within 1% of a weekly lower high that the daily chart confirms, an empty slot in the haven pick; green light: weekly and daily higher lows lift the buy filters and skip the cash week for 10 sessions; rebound rule: stays in stocks after a 12%+ drop with gold or bonds up 2%+ and a daily higher low; break re-entry rule: after a 10%+ drop, a weekly and a daily downtrend break (the daily one on fading volume) within 21 sessions hold stocks for 21 sessions; fading-energy filter: a top-5 stock whose volume and daily swings have both faded isn’t bought, its slot stays in cash; the whipsaw check counts the list with the filter off; buying-volume weighting: at each trade a held stock in the top third of the S&P 500 by up-day vs down-day volume over 3 months gets twice the money of the others; earnings-jump weighting: a held stock that closed 3%+ higher on its last earnings report within 3 months gets twice its money too; stretched-and-warned exit: when 3 or more of the eight dominoes are down and SPY is 2+ standard errors above its 52-week trend line, the haven for 20 sessions; near-the-high weighting: a held stock within 3% of its 1-year high gets twice its money too, no stock above 40% of the account; hot-commodity buy skip: no new metals or energy buy while copper or oil is up 50%+ over 6 months; unemployment step-aside: when the unemployment rate has climbed 0.3 points from its low of the year before while SPY is under its 150-day average, the haven for 21 sessions; the near-the-high doubling off while SPY is under its 150-day average)
previous: the same plan with the near-the-high doubling on in a down market too (default until Nov 2, 2026)
